Such amazing food and good service!
Aug 2026 • Family
The Solasta restaurant is such an amazing place to visit for dinner. We had the best time a few days ago so we had to go again tonight. We tried both the set menus and the seperate dishes and they are all amazing. The restaurant is very clean and the staff is very kind and they will provide you with anything you could ask for. I have tried steak, spaghetti, the shrimp and avocado salad and multiple desserts. All of them tasted very fresh and the presentation was great. 

Tonight, Tom was our server. Everyone is so kind but Tom gave us the most wonderful time at Solasta. His English was very advanced and he was very welcoming and funny towards me and my family. Tom made us feel like no request was too much and we could ask him about anything! He clearly loves what he does and I hope he will always have this spark to him that just lights up the entire restaurant! 
He is truly gifted ;)
Read more
Insider tip:
Talk to the staff and do not be afraid to ask them questions. They are so sweet and helpful!
